title: Cash Register (Cha-Ching)
blurb: Cha-ching — the mechanical bell of a till drawer opening, which is a sound most people now recognise entirely from television rather than from any shop they have visited this decade. It has become the internet's universal signal for profit in every form: a good deal, a payday landing, a scheme coming quietly together. Streamers wire it to donation alerts, editors fire it whenever anybody so much as mentions money. Satisfying, faintly greedy, and understood instantly in any language on earth without translation.
origin: The classic mechanical register bell, meme shorthand for profit.
